summary: iter179 testing: (1) backend GET /api/commissions/history structure + math + RBAC, (2) POST/GET/PUT /api/reinterventions photos, (3) frontend Commissions view toggle + CommissionHistory matrix, (4) accent-insensitive commercial search, (5) ReinterventionDialog photo capture/gallery/compression/lightbox. 15 pytest cases created (14 pass, 1 fail) + 4 Playwright runs. All 3 iter179 features work, BUT a pre-existing CRITICAL regression was found: GET /api/clients no longer exists (405) — the Clients page crashes and the reintervention 'global mode' client picker is empty, so a reintervention with photos cannot be created from the UI at all. Also found: the Commissions commercial dropdown filter does not match rows whose commercial name is a full name (Théo Fresh) while the dropdown lists team_members first names (Theo).

critical.issue: Endpoint MISSING -> 405 Method Not Allowed. `list_clients` was deleted from server.py in commit 8907b8d (iter169 global search) and never restored (openapi shows /api/clients only supports POST). Clients.jsx (api.get('/clients')) throws an Uncaught runtime error and shows 'Tous (0) / Aucun client'; ReinterventionDialog global mode gets a 'Method Not Allowed' toast and an empty client Select, blocking creation of any reintervention (with or without photos) from the UI.

minor.issue: months=0 silently falls back to 12 and months>36 clamps to 36 without any 422 — acceptable but undocumented; consider Query(ge=1, le=36).

Rows with an empty commercial name are aggregated under the literal label '—' and returned as a real 'commercial' row (visible in the UI matrix). Consider grouping/labelling explicitly (e.g. 'Non attribué').

Calls list_commissions(user) directly on every request, which triggers the lazy evolutive_ca reconcile (writes) — history is a read-only view; response time was ~1s on 11 rows and will grow linearly with sales volume.

ui_bugs.issue: Filter uses strict equality norm(r.commercial) === norm(commercialFilter). The dropdown is fed from team_members (first names: 'Theo', 'Kilian') while commission rows carry the user's full name ('Théo Fresh', 'Kilian Blanc'), so selecting Theo/Kilian returns 'Aucune commission' even though matching rows exist (verified: 'Thomas' works, 'Theo' and 'Kilian' return 0 rows). Use the same substring/norm() logic as the text search, or feed the dropdown from the commercial names present in rows.
Full-page 'Uncaught runtime errors: Request failed with status code 405' overlay + empty list (consequence of the missing GET /api/clients). No error state handling in Clients.jsx load().

The welcome dialog opens on every page for the admin and its DialogOverlay intercepts pointer events, blocking all clicks (Commissions toggle unclickable until 'Passer et fermer' is pressed). Also logs a React a11y warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle'. Add a data-testid to the skip/close button and a DialogTitle.

integration_issues.flow: Create reintervention with photos from the UI
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed end-to-end: global mode (Planning > Réintervention) has no selectable client because GET /api/clients is 405, and client-fiche mode is unreachable because the Clients page is broken. Photo attach/compress/preview/remove and the display of photos in the history all work; only the client selection is blocked.

issues: Matrix, sticky first column, month labels (oct. 24 … sept. 26), 6/12/24 switch and summary cards all render correctly and match the API (3 791 € / 500 € / 3 291 €)
A commercial with a 0 € commission (Thomas) renders a row of only em-dashes with '1 ligne' — visually looks like a bug; consider hiding zero-total commercials or showing 0 €
Row label '—' for sales without a commercial

action_items: CRITICAL: restore GET /api/clients (list_clients with check_perm(user,'clients','view','own') + cq(user) + _commercial_client_ids scope for commercials) — deleted in iter169; it breaks the Clients page and the reintervention creation flow.
HIGH: fix the Commissions commercial dropdown filter so 'Theo' matches 'Théo Fresh' (substring norm() match, or build the option list from row commercial names).
MEDIUM: prevent the onboarding modal overlay from blocking interactions on every page and add DialogTitle + data-testid on its skip button.

LOW: add loading/error state in Clients.jsx instead of an uncaught axios error; consider Query(ge=1,le=36) on /commissions/history months; remove the now-unused eslint-disable directives in CommissionHistory.jsx (lines 33 and 38 warn 'Unused eslint-disable directive').
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 9423 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; the missing GET /api/clients regression is a direct symptom (a route silently disappeared inside a large diff). Split into routers (clients, sales, commissions, planning...) and add a smoke test asserting every frontend-consumed endpoint exists.
commissions_history reuses list_commissions() (a route handler) as a helper; extract the pure aggregation into a service function so the history endpoint does not trigger write-side reconciliation.
Commissions.jsx filter: text search is accent-insensitive (correct) but the commercial dropdown uses strict equality on a different name source — the two filters must share one matching helper.

success_rate.backend: 93% (14/15 pytest cases; the only failure is the missing GET /api/clients)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (history view, toggle, month switch, accent text search, photo attach/compress/remove/lightbox OK; commercial dropdown filter and reintervention creation flow broken)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter179.py -v` — TestFrontendConsumedEndpoints::test_get_clients_listing_exists must go green once GET /api/clients is restored. In Playwright, ALWAYS dismiss the iter177 onboarding modal first (click text 'Passer et fermer') or its DialogOverlay blocks every click. The Commissions monthly view only exposes current+future month tabs, so Théo Fresh rows (commission_month 2026-08) are not reachable there; there is one Théo Fresh row in 2026-10 (tab 'Mois prochain — Octobre 2026') usable to retest the dropdown filter fix. Use /app/backend/tests/_iter179_seed_theo.py set|revert if you need a Théo row in the current month. /tmp/iter179_valid.jpg (2000x1200) is a valid image for testing the photo compression (verified: resized to 1600x960, ~13 KB data URI).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) GET /api/clients 405: `git log -S '@api_router.get("/clients")'` shows the handler was removed in commit 8907b8d (iter169 'Recherche globale Cmd/Ctrl+K') where the /api/search endpoint was inserted over the list_clients block; `grep -n list_clients server.py` now returns nothing and the local /openapi.json lists /api/clients with POST only. FastAPI therefore answers 405 for GET. Repro: GET {BACKEND}/api/clients with a valid admin bearer -> 405; open /clients in the UI -> uncaught AxiosError overlay. Fix: re-add the handler. 2) Dropdown filter: Commissions.jsx L184 does an exact normalized equality between the commission row's `commercial` (user full name, e.g. 'Théo Fresh') and the selected team_members name ('Theo'), so full-name vs first-name entries never match; the accent stripping itself works (text search 'theo'/'THÉO' both match).
